topic: K-Stick and the Backpack with the Bottomless Pocket
hook_text: K-Stick packs one tiny book... and loses his whole arm!
background: Simple bedroom or classroom corner with a plain floor, small table, and reusable backpack
main_expression: Confident grin changing to wide-eyed panic, then confused surprise
main_pose: Standing beside the backpack, leaning forward with one arm buried inside
scene_1: K-Stick proudly places one tiny book into the open backpack and zips it halfway shut.
scene_2: He reaches inside to retrieve the book, but his arm keeps disappearing deeper into the backpack. He pulls with his other hand, stretching comically.
scene_3: K-Stick finally yanks his arm free, holding the book... plus several identical red caps stacked on his hand.
twist_ending: He looks at the caps, then at the red cap already on his head. The backpack suddenly zips itself shut and whispers a tiny hiccup. K-Stick slowly hides his cap behind his back.
facebook_caption: He packed one book and somehow found a whole hat collection! 🎒😂
youtube_description: K-Stick discovers that his ordinary backpack has a very unusual pocket. What starts as a quick book grab turns into a surprising cap collection in this funny 15-second stickman reel.
image_prompt: A simple 2D family-friendly stickman cartoon frame featuring K-Stick, a black stickman with a round white face, big expressive eyes, and a signature red cap, standing beside an open small red-and-black backpack in a plain classroom or bedroom corner. His arm is comically deep inside the backpack, with a tiny book visible nearby and several identical red caps spilling from his hand.
